affected_subject.reason: Identifies Book._updateLimitPostOrder and the price-level doubly linked list it maintains.

trigger_or_action.reason: Appending a new order writes back-link to memory copy; cancelling/matching a non-head order triggers removal misbehavior.

direct_effect.reason: prevOrderId==0 in storage, headOrder moved past real head, orders orphaned, counters desynced, best bid/ask sentinel.

safety_relation_basis.reason: Explicit invariant: every order reachable via headOrder/tailOrder chain and open-interest reflects reachable orders only.

summary: Report identifies the affected function, the append/removal trigger, concrete corruption effects, and an explicit reachability/conservation invariant, sufficient to attempt formalization.
